column1: # The relay-URL table (v3.5.0, T-MOBILE-RELAY-VALIDATE): every signaling URL
# here must get the same verdict from the parser the connect path uses
# bridge's np_validate_relay_url, and therefore from the Android
# signalingConfigured) checks, which call the bridge and parse nothing
# Columns, tab-separated: verdict (accept | refuse), url, why.
# The url column is taken byte for byte, except: the token <empty> is the
# empty string, and \n is a newline. The apps trim user input before asking;
# the validator itself refuses surrounding whitespace.

column3: userinfo (sent by the handshake as given)
empty (the apps treat empty as "hosted lobby" before asking)
non-numeric port (Android's regex accepted it; connect dialled 443)
unclosed IPv6 literal (Android's regex accepted it)
unclosed IPv6 literal with a port
junk after an IPv6 literal (connect dialled 443)
upper-case scheme: the connect path refuses it (Android's regex accepted it)
